extraction_plan: Prioritize sections that define how the sensor is triggered and how distance is computed: extract GPIO mode timing from the measurement operation and GPIO sections, especially the TRIG pulse width and echo timing behavior. Use the performance parameters section for timing/electrical limits. Extract the distance conversion formula and any calibration constants from the formula section. If protocol support beyond GPIO is included, extract UART/IIC command tables, response bytes, and addressing rules, but treat them as secondary for the target gpio_timing polling driver. Interface definition should be used to map pins and roles. Mode-selection and initialization notes should be captured for configuration requirements and power/state assumptions.
extraction_notes: This device is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic ranging module; for a gpio_timing polling driver, the most important outputs are trigger pulse timing, echo measurement timing, and the distance formula. The document also includes UART and IIC variants or modes, so protocol-related sections are high relevance even if they may not be used by the selected driver type. No true register map is expected for a pure GPIO-timing sensor, so any command/address extraction is only applicable to the alternate UART/IIC modes. Sections with tables should be mined carefully because they likely contain the most actionable parameters.
